PLAN "12-week Strength & Hypertrophy"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Increase strength and improve body composition"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1 - Foundation" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Upper Strength":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 4x5 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          barbell_row 4x6 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          overhead_press 3x6 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          pull_up 3x5 rpe 9 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 60m "Lower Strength":
        warmup:
          jogging 5m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x5 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x6 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          lung e 3x8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 60m "Full Hypertrophy":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x8..10 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          leg_press 3x10..12 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x10..12 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          lateral_raise 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 5m
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Upper Strength":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 4x5 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          barbell_row 4x6 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          overhead_press 3x6 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          pull_up 3x5 rpe 9 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 60m "Lower Strength":
        warmup:
          jogging 5m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x5 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x6 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          split_squat 3x8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 60m "Full Hypertrophy":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x8..10 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          leg_press 3x10..12 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x10..12 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          lateral_raise 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 5m
    WEEK 3:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Upper Strength":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 4x5 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          bent_over_row 4x6 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          overhead_press 3x6 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          chin_up 3x5 rpe 9 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 60m "Lower Strength":
        warmup:
          jogging 5m
        main straight_sets:
          front_squat 4x5 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x6 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          walking_lunge 3x8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 60m "Full Hypertrophy":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          seated_row 3x8..10 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          hack_squat 3x10..12 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x10..12 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          lateral_raise 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 5m
    WEEK 4:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Upper Strength - Deload":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 3x5 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          barbell_row 3x6 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          overhead_press 2x6 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          pull_up 2x5 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 2x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 60m "Lower Strength - Deload":
        warmup:
          jogging 5m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x5 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 2x6 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          split_squat 2x8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 60m "Hypertrophy - Deload":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 2x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          seated_row 2x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          leg_press 2x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 2x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lateral_raise 2x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 5m
  PHASE "Phase 2 - Build" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Monday training 70m "Upper Heavy":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 5x3 rpe 9 rest 150 seconds
          barbell_row 4x6 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          overhead_press 4x5 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          pull_up 4x5 rpe 9 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 70m "Lower Heavy":
        warmup:
          jogging 5m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 5x3 rpe 9 rest 150 seconds
          deadlift 3x5 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          split_squat 3x6 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 70m "Upper Hypertrophy":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 4x8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          seated_row 4x8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_press 3x10..12 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          lateral_raise 4x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          bicep_curl 3x10..12 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 5m
    WEEK 6:
      DAY Monday training 70m "Upper Heavy":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 5x3 rpe 9 rest 150 seconds
          bent_over_row 4x6 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          overhead_press 4x5 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          chin_up 4x5 rpe 9 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 70m "Lower Heavy":
        warmup:
          jogging 5m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 5x3 rpe 9 rest 150 seconds
          trap_bar_deadlift 3x5 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          walking_lunge 3x6 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 70m "Upper Hypertrophy":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 4x8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 4x8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_press 3x10..12 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          lateral_raise 4x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          bicep_curl 3x10..12 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 5m
    WEEK 7:
      DAY Monday training 70m "Upper Heavy":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 5x3 rpe 9 rest 150 seconds
          barbell_row 4x6 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          overhead_press 4x5 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          pull_up 4x5 rpe 9 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 70m "Lower Heavy":
        warmup:
          jogging 5m
        main straight_sets:
          front_squat 5x3 rpe 9 rest 150 seconds
          deadlift 3x5 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          split_squat 3x6 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 70m "Full Hypertrophy":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 4x8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          seated_row 4x8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          leg_press 4x10..12 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 4x10..12 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          lateral_raise 4x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 5m
    WEEK 8:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Upper - Deload":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 3x3 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          barbell_row 3x5 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          overhead_press 2x5 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          pull_up 2x5 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 2x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 60m "Lower - Deload":
        warmup:
          jogging 5m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x3 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 2x5 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          split_squat 2x6 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 60m "Hypertrophy - Deload":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 2x8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          seated_row 2x8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          leg_press 2x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 2x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lateral_raise 2x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 5m
  PHASE "Phase 3 - Peak & Recompose" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Monday training 75m "Upper Power":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 6x2 rpe 9 rest 180 seconds
          barbell_row 4x6 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          overhead_press 4x4 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          pull_up 4x5 rpe 9 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 75m "Lower Power":
        warmup:
          jogging 5m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 6x2 rpe 9 rest 180 seconds
          trap_bar_deadlift 4x4 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          walking_lunge 3x6 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 75m "Full Hypertrophy":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 4x8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          seated_row 4x8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          leg_press 4x10 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 4x10 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          lateral_raise 4x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 5m
    WEEK 10:
      DAY Monday training 75m "Upper Mix":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 5x3 rpe 9 rest 150 seconds
          bent_over_row 4x6 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          overhead_press 4x4 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          chin_up 4x5 rpe 9 rest 90 seconds
          bicep_curl 3x10 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 75m "Lower Mix":
        warmup:
          jogging 5m
        main straight_sets:
          front_squat 5x3 rpe 9 rest 150 seconds
          deadlift 3x3 rpe 9 rest 180 seconds
          hip_thrust 4x8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 75m "Full Recomp":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 4x8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 4x8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          leg_press 4x10 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 4x10 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          lateral_raise 4x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 5m
    WEEK 11:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Upper - Intensity":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 4x4 rpe 9 rest 150 seconds
          barbell_row 4x6 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          overhead_press 3x5 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          pull_up 3x5 rpe 9 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 60m "Lower - Intensity":
        warmup:
          jogging 5m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x4 rpe 9 rest 150 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x6 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          split_squat 3x6 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 60m "Hypertrophy - Volume":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 4x8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          seated_row 4x8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          leg_press 4x10..12 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 4x10..12 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          lateral_raise 4x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 5m
    WEEK 12:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Peak - Deload":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 3x3 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          barbell_row 3x5 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          overhead_press 2x5 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          pull_up 2x5 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 2x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 60m "Lower - Deload":
        warmup:
          jogging 5m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x3 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 2x5 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          split_squat 2x6 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 60m "Maintenance":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 3x8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          seated_row 3x8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          leg_press 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lateral_raise 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 5m
